title: Kiln — Lathe & Glaze Studio
description: Draw a silhouette, watch it turn on the wheel as a watertight vessel, glaze it, and download the printable STL.
concept: Kiln is a potter's wheel in a browser tab. You shape a half-profile with draggable control points; the app revolves it into a closed, wall-thick solid in real time — rim, inner cavity, floor and all — and renders it with a hand-written WebGL glaze shader. Eight glazes, six surface patterns, flutes, twist, wobble and throwing rings turn one silhouette into very different pots. Every piece exports as OBJ or binary STL (slicer-ready), photographs as a PNG, saves to a localStorage shelf with a thumbnail, and travels as a URL.
features: Profile editor: drag, add and delete control points with Catmull-Rom smoothing you can switch off
Real surface-of-revolution mesher — closed cross-section gives a watertight solid with a real wall, rim and floor
Form controls: height, girth, wall thickness, facets, flutes, flute depth, twist and wobble
Eight glaze presets plus six procedural glaze patterns (plain, rings, speckle, drip, spiral, crackle) with matte, speckle, drip and throwing-ring sliders
Orbit/pinch camera, turntable spin, wireframe view and three lighting rigs
Export binary STL (printable) and Wavefront OBJ with normals, plus a composited PNG studio shot
The Shelf: localStorage gallery of saved pieces with JPEG thumbnails, plus share links that rebuild the pot from the URL hash
tech: WebGL2 with WebGL1 fallback, hand-written GLSL ES 1.00 glaze shader (value-noise fbm, half-Lambert key, Blinn speculars, cavity occlusion, Reinhard tone map)
Surface-of-revolution mesher with central-difference normals on a doubly-closed grid and outward-orientation correction
Catmull-Rom profile resampling with monotonic-y clamping
Canvas 2D profile editor driven by Pointer Events
Binary STL writer (DataView) and Wavefront OBJ writer
canvas.toBlob PNG export composited over a studio gradient
localStorage shelf with JPEG thumbnails and base64url URL-hash sharing

interaction.mouse: Drag in the viewport to orbit; wheel to zoom; drag profile dots to reshape the pot.
interaction.click: Click empty profile space to add a point, double-click a point to remove it, tap glazes and patterns to reglaze.
interaction.touch: Three tabs (Profile / Wheel / Glaze); one finger orbits, two fingers pinch to zoom, tap-drag edits the silhouette.
interaction.keyboard: Space toggles the turntable, W wireframe, L lighting, G cycles glazes, S saves to the shelf, Delete removes the selected point.
